name: ModelVariant130_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant130_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (up to 64 sprites fly from a model part to random targets and fade); for a non-negative request it selects the 0x16-byte command row at gModelVariant130_D0B88 indexed by the request modulo 100 and packs the texture at gModelVariant130_D0B6C, otherwise it runs one frame of the sprite flight and returns 4, 2, 1 or 0 from its phase checks; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; all seven regions build the same source without a selector. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
